'''Warr'an''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] residing on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. While station in [[Outpost Rennar]], Warr'an held concerns regarding the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperials]] present in the base, to which [[Zola Arvannus]] was forced to come in to ensure good relations with the Mandalorians.<ref name="TOR:DC" />
